repeated_runtime_observation.failure: UE did not attach within 180 seconds under the standardized time-varying CIRDB trace
repeated_runtime_observation.contrast: The same fresh VRTSIM images, topology, timescale 1.0 and min_rxtxtime 6 passed three independently recreated passthrough repetitions before CIRDB was enabled.

source_findings.finding: CIRDB update and channel convolution run synchronously in the VRTSIM transmit path before samples are written to shared memory.
When the trace step changes, the provider synchronously seeks, reads one snapshot, copies its taps and publishes the next channel descriptor.

VRTSIM already accumulates transmit lateness, receive lateness, transmit budget and channel-processing delay, but prints the aggregates only during device teardown. The failure-path logs were captured before teardown, so these counters are absent from Phase 3C8 evidence.
Pinned OAI documentation explicitly states that real-time issues can prevent UE connection, especially with channel modelling enabled.

frozen_trace_diagnostics_over_steps_0_th.purpose: exclude a persistent zero-energy or grossly discontinuous input as the sole explanation; these diagnostics do not prove runtime correctness
frozen_trace_diagnostics_over_steps_0_th.interpretation: The trace contains deep instantaneous frequency-selective fades but is neither persistently zero nor temporally independent. Because the UE failed every synchronization attempt across 180 seconds, simple persistent attenuation is not sufficient to explain the result.

supported: plain VRTSIM passthrough is supported under the corrected observation window
the CIRDB provider selected and advanced the frozen trace without reported snapshot skips
the complete CIRDB/channel-processing condition repeatedly prevents initial attachment
the late-PRACH-job signature is absent from the three successful Phase 3C7 passthrough logs
not_supported: that CIRDB file delivery alone is the cause
that the standardized trace coefficients alone are the cause
that channel convolution alone is the cause
that min_rxtxtime or timescale should be changed adaptively
that a particular code change will restore attachment
